scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: Failed to show empathy at [02:50] when customer voiced extreme panic regarding her emergency medical lifeline pendant and vulnerable living conditions.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Failed to paraphrase customer's severe landline static fault in own words.

scorecard.name: Active listening
scorecard.coaching: Asked customer at [08:40] for her telephone handset model which had already been verified at [00:45].

grader.scenario: Landline crackling noise and static interference on master test socket
grader.notes: Good technical fault logging and vulnerable customer priority booking, but agent failed empathy regarding life-critical medical alarm pendant, offered no paraphrase, and repeated a question about handset model in the last third of the call.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net landline fault services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Joanne throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Customer expressed acute fear and panic regarding emergency medical lifeline pendant; agent offered zero empathy and quoted technical fault causes.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent never restated the landline static problem in his own words.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent asked for telephone handset model at turn 36 despite customer providing Panasonic KX-TG at turn 3.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent attached vulnerable medical priority flag, booked next-morning engineer, and provided reference FLT-88192-K.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a courteous instructional tone throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked relevant questions regarding test socket checks and noise characteristics.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer confirmed next-morning priority engineer booking agreed and noted reference code.
